Brand Introduction:
Welcome to My Home Design, your premier destination for elegant and stylish home furnishings. Located in Australia, we pride ourselves on offering a curated selection of high-quality furniture that combines timeless design with modern functionality. Whether you're looking to revamp your living space or find the perfect piece to complete a room, My Home Design has something for every taste and style.

Product Description:
At My Home Design, we offer an extensive range of furniture and home decor items, including luxurious beds, exquisite console tables, comfortable sofas, and much more. Our products are crafted from the finest materials, ensuring durability and lasting beauty. For instance, our Baobab wood console table, available in natural and oak finishes, showcases our commitment to quality and design.

USP (Unique Selling Point):

  • Customizable Options: Many of our products, like the MARIE ANTOINETTE BED, come with customizable features to better fit your space and style needs.
  • High-Quality Materials: We use premium materials in all our products, ensuring longevity and elegance.
  • Exclusive Designs: Our furniture is designed to stand out, offering unique pieces that you won't find anywhere else.
  • Exceptional Customer Service: We strive to provide outstanding customer support, ensuring a seamless shopping experience from start to finish.

Payment Terms:
As an affiliate, you will earn a competitive commission on every sale generated through your unique referral links or discount codes. Commissions are paid out on a monthly basis, and you can accumulate points or cash that can be exchanged for products from My Home Design. Detailed payment terms and conditions will be provided upon joining the program.

Other Information:

  • Easy Signup: Join our affiliate program with a simple and quick registration process.
  • Marketing Support: We provide a range of marketing materials, including banners, product images, and content, to help you promote our brand effectively.
  • Dedicated Affiliate Support: Our affiliate team is here to assist you with any questions or concerns, ensuring you have all the tools and support needed for success.
  • Exclusive Offers: Affiliates get access to exclusive promotions and discounts that can be shared with their audience to drive more sales.

Join the My Home Design Affiliate Program today and start earning rewards while helping your followers discover beautiful, high-quality furniture that transforms their homes!

My Home Design Affiliate Program Terms and Conditions

Effective Date: [Insert Date]

1. Introduction
Welcome to the My Home Design Affiliate Program. By signing up to be an affiliate in the My Home Design Affiliate Program ("Program"), you agree to be bound by the following terms and conditions ("Terms and Conditions"). Please ensure that you read them carefully before participating in the Program.

2. Enrollment in the Program
To begin the enrollment process, you must submit a completed Program application through our website. We will evaluate your application and notify you of its acceptance or rejection. We reserve the right to approve or reject any Affiliate Program registration in our sole and absolute discretion. You will have no legal recourse against us for the rejection of your Affiliate Program registration.

3. Affiliate Responsibilities
As an affiliate of My Home Design, you agree to:

  • Promote our products on your website, blog, social media, or other channels using your unique affiliate link or coupon code.
  • Comply with all applicable laws and regulations, including but not limited to those related to marketing and advertising.
  • Not engage in any misleading, fraudulent, or unethical behavior in promoting our products.

4. Affiliate Links and Coupon Codes
Once you have been approved as an affiliate, you will be provided with a unique affiliate link or coupon code to track sales generated from your referrals. It is your responsibility to ensure that these links and codes are properly integrated and used. If a person clicks on someone else’s referral link and then later clicks on yours, yours is the one that counts. If a customer both clicks on the affiliate link and uses a coupon code, you will not receive a double commission.

5. Commissions and Payments

  • Commission Rate: Affiliates will earn 5% commission on total referral sales up to $6,000 and up to 10% commission on total referral sales exceeding $6,000 when a customer makes a purchase through your affiliate link or uses your coupon code.
  • Flat Rate for Sales Items: A maximum of a flat rate of $200 will be paid for sales of products that are on sale at the moment of purchase, provided the product price surpasses $4,000. The exact amount will be determined by My Home Design during sales campaigns.
  • Payout Schedule: Commissions are paid out via bank transfer within 60 days of the end of each calendar month. Payments will be made via [insert payment method].
  • Store Credit: In addition to earning cash commissions, affiliates can build credit in cash toward store credit at My Home Design. This store credit can be used to purchase products from our store.
  • Minimum Payout Threshold: The minimum payout threshold is $100. If your total commissions for a given month are below this threshold, the amount will be carried over to the next month.
  • Returns and Cancellations: If a product is returned or an order is canceled, the corresponding commission will be deducted from your account, as the sale has not been successfully completed.

6. Promotional Restrictions
Affiliates are prohibited from:

  • Using their affiliate links or coupon codes for their own purchases.
  • Using spam to promote My Home Design products.
  • Misrepresenting the relationship between you and My Home Design (e.g., implying that you are an employee or directly associated with My Home Design).

7. Marketing Tools
We may share promotional media such as banners, logos, or specific collection promotions with you through the Marketing Tool tab. You can download the media or get the HTML embed code to share on affiliate channels.

8. Removal from Referral Program
If an affiliate wishes to be removed from the affiliate program, they can do so by contacting: partnerships@myhomedesign.com.au.

9. Termination
Either party may terminate this Agreement at any time, with or without cause, by giving the other party written notice of termination.My Home Design reserves the right to terminate any partnership at any time if deemed appropriate. Upon termination, you will cease all use of, and delete, all links, trademarks, logos, and other materials provided by or on behalf of us to you pursuant to this Agreement.

10. Limitation of Liability
We will not be liable for any indirect, special, or consequential damages (or any loss of revenue, profits, or data) arising in connection with this Agreement or the Program, even if we have been advised of the possibility of such damages.

11. Disclaimers
We make no express or implied warranties or representations with respect to the Program or any products sold through the Program (including, without limitation, warranties of fitness, merchantability, non-infringement, or any implied warranties arising out of a course of performance, dealing, or trade usage). In addition, we make no representation that the operation of our site will be uninterrupted or error-free, and we will not be liable for the consequences of any interruptions or errors.

12. Modifications
We may modify any of the terms and conditions contained in this Agreement at any time and at our sole discretion. You will be notified by email of any changes. Modifications may include, but are not limited to, changes in the scope of available commissions, commission schedules, payment procedures, and Program rules, including changes to the commission structure towards store credit to be decided by My Home Design. If any modification is unacceptable to you, your only option is to terminate this Agreement. Your continued participation in the Program following the posting of the change notice or new Agreement on our site will indicate your agreement to the changes.

13. Governing Law
This Agreement shall be governed by and interpreted in accordance with the laws of Australia, NSW, without regard to the conflicts of laws and principles thereof.

14. Independent Contractor
You and we are independent contractors, and nothing in this Agreement will create any partnership, joint venture, agency, franchise, sales representative, or employment relationship between the parties. You will have no authority to make or accept any offers or representations on our behalf.

15. Contact Information
If you have any questions about these Terms and Conditions, please contact us at:

  • Email: partnerships@myhomedesign.com.au

By signing up for the My Home Design Affiliate Program, you acknowledge that you have read, understood, and agree to be bound by these Terms and Conditions.

My Home Design
